title: One Small Step (Apollo 11)
sourceTitle: Apollo 11: "That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind." (a11step.aiff)
author: NASA (Neil Armstrong, 21 July 1969 UTC)
licenceNote: NASA mission audio, a work of the U.S. government (not subject to copyright in the U.S.). Also on Commons as File:Phrase_de_Neil_Armstrong.oga with {{PD-USGov-NASA}}.
changes: Decoded the 8-bit signed 22,254 Hz AIFF, ended at 6.66 s (before a static click) with an 80 ms fade-out, resampled to 44.1 kHz mono, peak-normalized to -1 dBFS, MP3 64 kbps mono. The radio hiss is original.

transcript.text: That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind.
transcript.textSource: Wording as printed on the NASA NSSDC page https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/lunar/apollo11.html (NASA's Apollo Lunar Surface Journal writes "for (a) man").
transcript.timing: Approximate (about +-0.15 s): word boundaries placed at dips in speech-band (300-3400 Hz) energy measured in 20 ms frames (pauses and stop-consonant closures), then shifted +20 ms for the MP3 encoder delay (measured by comparing the source and the decoded MP3). Not checked by ear.
